court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Superintendent of Police and Another .…. Respondents.
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. R.S. Selvam Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for writ of mandamus forbearing the respondents herein from interfering with and threatening the petitioner to take water in the property comprised in Plot No. 4 in S.F. No. 355-A of Muthanampalayam Village, Tiruppur District, Tirupur for taking water for domestic and drinking purpose of the petitioner's family and their tenants.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This writ petition has been filed to forbear the respondents herein from interfering with and threatening the petitioner to take water in the property comprised in Plot No. 4 in S.F. No. 355-A of Muthanampalayam Village, Tiruppur District, Tirupur.

2. It is represented by the learned counsel for the petitioner that subsequent to the filing of this writ petition, the respondent has not prevented the petitioner from drawing water in the property comprised in Plot No. 4 in S.F. No. 355-A of Muthanampalayam Village, Tiruppur District, Tirupur. Therefore, according to him, nothing survives for further adjudication in this writ petition.

3. Recording the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
